note.value:
Initial Setup: A Necromancer starts with all Necromancy cards.

Casting Spells: Roll above casting value to cast a spell. After a successful cast, roll a die: 1-2 Discard spell as normal; 3-5: May discard a different spell; 6: May keep spell.

Dispelling Spells: Discard 2 Necromancy spells. Roll above the casting value of the lowest dispelling card.

Dispelling Necromancy: Color Wizards must use their college to dispell Necromancy. Other magic types dispell as normal.

End Phase: If out of cards, redraw entire hand.
